messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from Annexure to IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 5):
"""
Sum Insured can be changed (increased/decreased) only at the time of renewal or at any time, subject to underwriting by the company. For increase in SI, the waiting period if any shall start afresh only for the enhanced portion of the sum insured Moratorium Period: After completion of Five continuous years under the policy no look back to be applied. This period of Five years is called as moratorium period. The moratorium would be applicable for the sums insured of the first policy and subsequently completion of Five continuous years would be applicable from date of enhancement of sums insured only on the enhanced limits. After the expiry of Moratorium Period no health insurance policy shall be contestable except for proven fraud and permanent exclusions specified in the policy contract.
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}

For an increase, the waiting period starts afresh only for the enhanced portion of the sum insured.","facts":["Sum Insured can be changed (increased/decreased) only at the time of renewal or at any time, subject to underwriting by the company.","For increase in SI, the waiting period if any shall start afresh only for the enhanced portion of the sum insured"]} ,{"question":"What is the moratorium period for contestability of a health insurance policy, and when does it end?","answer":"After five continuous years under the policy, no look‑back is applied; the moratorium period ends after five continuous years from the date of enhancement of the sum insured, after which the policy is not contestable except for fraud or permanent exclusions.","facts":["After completion of Five continuous years under the policy no look back to be applied.","This period of Five years is called as moratorium period.","The moratorium would be applicable for the sums insured of the first policy and subsequently completion of Five continuous years would be applicable from date of enhancement of sums insured only on the enhanced limits."]}]}
